blocks.text: Elevate your on-the-go experience with the Lenovo Chromebook Duet. Weighing just over a pound and super slim, it’s as easy to hold as a paperback. Shift from laptop to portrait mode with the versatile kickstand. Fast Boot on ChromeOS keeps you moving fast by powering on in under 10 seconds. It’s not just a device, but a lifestyle transformer that’s powered by the MediaTek Kompanio 838 processor’s on-device AI. The 10.95" display sports narrow bezels for maximum screen as you binge-watch YouTube videos or jam with booming clarity via SmartAMP with Waves MaxxAudio®. The full-metal chassis is designed for extreme durability and rated for military-grade toughness. Impressively versatile, crafted to impress. Life as you know it just got easier and better. (1) *$59.97 value, for a limited time only. The Google AI Pro trial offer is available to eligible users with the purchase and activation of an eligible Chromebook on or after May 28, 2024. This offer is limited to users in Australia, Belgium, Canada, Denmark, Finland, France, Germany, India, Ireland, Italy, Japan, Luxembourg, Mexico, Netherlands, New Zealand, Norway, Poland, Portugal, South Africa, Spain, Sweden, Taiwan, United Kingdom and United States. Redeem the offer by January 31, 2026 at 11:59pm PT. Valid form of payment required at sign-up, but you will not be charged until the trial period expires. $19.99/month at offer end. Cancel anytime. Gemini in Google AI Pro and Gemini for Gmail, Docs, and more are only available for ages 18+. Gemini for Gmail, Docs and more is available in select languages. items: LIFE TRANSFORMING – The Lenovo Chromebook Duet is where power meets portability. Amazingly durable, the 2-in-1 convertible laptop is your perfect companion for life on-the-go.
ALWAYS READY TO GO – With its perfectly portable size, folio keyboard, and all-day battery life, the lightweight Lenovo Chromebook Duet is ready for anything you throw at it.
ADAPTS TO YOUR EVERY MOVE – Impressively versatile, crafted to impress. The durable design is encased in a full-metal chassis, fortified with tough Corning glass, and supported by a soft folio stand.

SMILE, SNAP, SHARE - Get ready to take phenomenal photos, even in low light thanks to cutting-edge image processing technology. The front camera comes with a physical shutter to ensure your video calls capture every detail, while keeping your privacy at your fingertips.

NOT SHORT ON PORTS - Plug into unlimited functionality with two USB Type-C connections. They ensure you can transfer large pictures and videos quickly, enjoy smooth video chats, and connect to external displays.
EDGE-TO-EDGE EPICS – Your life just became cinematic on the 10.95” WUXGA IPS touch display, designed with narrow bezels for maximum viewing pleasure.
PRODUCTIVITY SIMPLIFIED - The MediaTek Kompanio 838 processor delivers speedy performance, seamless on-device AI processing, and snappy powering in under 10 seconds via Fast Boot on ChromeOS.
STREAM IN STYLE - Boosted with SmartAMP via Waves MaxxAudio, enjoy rich stereo sound that’s equally immersive while playing your music and movies.

GET GOOGLE AI PRO, 2TB OF STORAGE, AND MORE FOR 3 MONTHS AT NO COST – Boost your productivity and creativity with 3 months of Google AI Pro –now including NotebookLM– on us when you purchase a Chromebook.(1)
